(Capacity: 10,258) | tourney = [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result= First Round }} {{2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 USC Trojans men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Southern California]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Trojans were led by 10th-year head coach [[Andy Enfield]] and played their home games at the [[Galen Center]] for the 16th season in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 22–11, 14–6 in [[2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Play]] to finish in 4th place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 Tournament]] to [[2022–23 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] where they lost in the First Round to [[2022–23 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]]. ==Previous season== {{see also|2021–22 USC Trojans men's basketball team}} The [[2021–22 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC Trojans]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 26–8, 14–6 in [[2021–22 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Play]] to finish in third place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2022 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], they defeated [[2021–22 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] in the quarterfinals before losing in the semifinals to [[2021–22 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 7 seed in the Midwest Region, where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami (FL)]]. ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" !
